ratings.notes: Solid structure but lacks clinical trial evidence and disease-specificity nuance. Graph-derived section adds little. Limitations well-stated but incomplete on trial heterogeneity.
Best overall: covers animal, human, clinical trial, and mechanistic evidence. Includes disease-specificity of IL-17 blockade failure (lupus, IBD). Limitations comprehensive and nuanced.
Excellent breadth: genetics, animal, clinical, mechanistic. No PMIDs cited, reducing grounding score. Mentions IL-17F redundancy and microbiome—valuable nuances absent elsewhere.
Strong evidence hierarchy with PMIDs. Includes Th17 plasticity point. Limitations section cut off mid-sentence. Slightly less complete than B/C on disease-specificity of blockade failures.

result.pairwise_reason: PP004-B provides the most complete and well-grounded response, integrating animal mechanistic data, human associative evidence, clinical trial validation, and nuanced limitations including disease-specific failures of IL-17 blockade and patient selection bias, all with PMID citations.
